% Data: figures/data/continuation.csv, generated by scripts/make_figures.py from
% research/controlled-studies-20261014.json (adaptation.full_minus_heads, effective_outcomes).
\definecolor{pvblue}{RGB}{0,114,178}
\definecolor{pvorange}{RGB}{213,94,0}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
  width=\columnwidth, height=4.6cm, ybar, bar width=6pt,
  symbolic x coords={42,43,44}, xtick=data, enlarge x limits=0.25,
  xlabel={Training seed (every FULL candidate failed the guard)}, ylabel={Cases, FULL vs HEADS},
  ymajorgrids, ymin=-60, ymax=140, tick label style={font=\small}, label style={font=\small},
  legend style={font=\small, at={(0.5,1.04)}, anchor=south, legend columns=2, draw=none},
  extra y ticks=0, extra y tick style={grid=none, tick style={draw=none}},
]
\addplot[fill=pvblue, draw=pvblue] table[x=seed, y=joint_gain, col sep=comma]{figures/data/continuation.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvblue!25, draw=pvblue] table[x=seed, y=joint_loss, col sep=comma]{figures/data/continuation.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvorange, draw=pvorange] table[x=seed, y=action_gain, col sep=comma]{figures/data/continuation.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvorange!25, draw=pvorange] table[x=seed, y=action_loss, col sep=comma]{figures/data/continuation.csv};
\legend{Joint gains, Joint losses, Action gains, Action losses}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
